blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reconstructing complete 3D object assets from monocular or sparse multi-view observations remains challenging. Generative 3D foundation models can complete object geometry beyond the observed views, but their predictions may not faithfully reproduce the observed geometry, appearance, or pose. We introduce GenIA, a framework for test-time input-aligned generation that grounds SAM3D's generative prior in geometric and photometric observations without retraining the foundation model. We improve object pose by deriving translation and scale from geometry while retaining the learned rotation prior, and align appearance through visibility-biased attention, cross-observation fusion, and differentiable rendering guidance during denoising. An optional post-denoising refinement further adapts the appearance latent, lightweight decoder adapters, and object placement to the observations. Our framework also supports externally supplied geometry; when given temporal shapes of dynamic objects, it recovers a shared, input-aligned canonical appearance and stable world-space placement. Across synthetic and real benchmarks, GenIA improves pose prediction and object reconstruction from monocular, multi-view, and dynamic inputs, outperforming recent optimization-based, per-frame image-to-3D, and video-to-4D methods. Our project page is available at https://facebookresearch.github.io/GenIA.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Photorealistic 3D reconstruction requires recovering complete geometry, faithful appearance, and correct placement from one or more observations.
For dynamic objects, these properties must also remain coherent over time.
Such assets are central to content creation, immersive media, robotics simulation, and embodied AI, yet remain difficult to recover from casual images or videos.
The core challenge is to combine generative priors that complete unseen regions with reconstruction constraints that faithfully reproduce the observed evidence.

blocks.en:
Recent 3D foundation models learn strong generative priors from large-scale data, but often trade fidelity to the observed inputs for generative completeness.
SAM3D [ 9 ] , for example, predicts complete object geometry, appearance, and rigid pose from a single image, but its geometry and appearance may not tightly reproduce the observations, and its pose estimates can be inaccurate.
At the other extreme, pixel-aligned predictors like Pixal3D [ 28 ] faithfully reconstruct observed geometry and appearance but offer weaker completion of unseen regions and typically do not recover explicit object pose.
Another line of work narrows this gap by retraining generative models with reconstruction cues: ReconViaGen [ 3 ] conditions structured-latent generation on multi-view features and steers sampling toward the inputs, while CUPID [ 15 ] jointly recovers camera pose and injects pixel-aligned features into a single-image generator.
However, both specialize the generator to a particular input setting at training time, and neither addresses dynamic objects.
blocks.zh:
最近的3D基础模型从大规模数据中学习出强烈的基因前科,但往往用忠于观察输入来换取基因完整性.
例如,SAM3D [9] 预测完全的物体几何,外观,以及从一幅图像得到的刚性姿势,但其几何和外观可能不会紧紧地复制观测结果,而其姿势估计可能不准确.
在另一个极端,像素相通的预测器,如Pixal3D [28] 忠实地重建所观察到的几何和外观,但能较弱地完成看不见的区域,而且通常不会恢复显性物体外观.
另一行工作通过再培训带有重建提示的基因模型来缩小这一差距:ReconViaGen [3]在多视图特性上具备结构化-相对生成条件并引导采样向投入方向走去,而CUPID [15] 联合恢复相机姿势并注入像素相通特性到单图像生成器上.
然而,两者都使生成器在训练时都专门用于特定的输入设置,并且都没有处理动态对象.

blocks.en:
In this work, we instead align the generative prior to its inputs at inference time, without retraining the foundation model.
We call this approach test-time I nput- A ligned Gen eration (GenIA).
Geometric and photometric signals constrain the observed regions, while the generative is steered toward consistent completion of what remains unseen.
The same mechanism spans monocular, multi-view, and dynamic inputs.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们是在推论时间投入之前调整基因的,而不对基础模式进行再培训。
我们称这个方法为测试时间Input——一个相位基因分解(GenIA).
几何和光度信号制约着观测到的区域,而基因结构则被引导到持续完成未见的事物。
同一机制涉及单一、多视图和动态输入。

blocks.en:
GenIA aligns generation to the observations at three levels.
First, we recover translation and scale using depth-derived cues while retaining the generative rotation prior.
Second, we condition appearance on geometry and visibility, directing local features toward the image regions that observe them and fusing predictions across views or frames with visibility weighting.
Third, differentiable rendering provides both in-trajectory guidance and optional
post-denoising refinement.
Our grounding mechanisms are geometry-predictor agnostic and therefore also support externally supplied shapes.
We demonstrate this with ActionMesh [ 60 ] , which provides canonical dynamic geometry but neither world-space placement nor appearance; GenIA complements it with input-aligned canonical appearance and temporally stable rigid placement.
blocks.zh:
GenIA在三个层次上将生成与观测相协调.
首先,我们利用深度提示来恢复翻译和规模,同时保留先基因旋转。
第二,我们以几何学和能见度为条件,将局部特征引导到观测这些特征的图像区域,并用能见度加权的方法在各种观点或框架之间产生振荡预测。
第三,不同的渲染既提供了内向导,也提供了可选性
后德化精进.
我们的地基机制是几何-先导不可知的,因此也支持外部提供的形状。
我们用ActionMesh[60]来证明这一点,它提供了犬形动态几何,但既不提供世界空间定位,也不提供外观;GenIA用输入相通的犬形外观和时间上稳定的刚性定位来补充它。

blocks.en: GenIA improves pose and object reconstruction from monocular and multi-view inputs without retraining the underlying foundation model, and produces temporally consistent dynamic video reconstructions. It outperforms per-frame image-to-3D, optimization-based, and recent video-to-4D methods on both real and synthetic benchmarks.
blocks.zh: GenIA从单一和多视图输入改进了姿势和对象重建,而不对基础模型进行再培训,并产生时间上一致的动态视频重建. 它在真实基准和合成基准上,超越了每帧图像到3D,基于优化,以及近期的视频到4D方法.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are: 1. An inference-time framework that aligns SAM3D’s generative prior with geometric and photometric observations without retraining the foundation model, optionally supporting externally supplied temporal geometry. 2. A visibility-aware appearance approach combining attention bias, rendering guidance, and cross-observation fusion for monocular, multi-view, and dynamic inputs, all applied to the frozen generator. 3. A geometry-grounded object placement strategy with sequence-level rotation
aggregation for improved and temporally stable poses. 4. An optional post-denoising refinement that jointly optimizes the appearance latent, lightweight decoder adapters, and object placement via differentiable rendering, bridging the gap between the frozen decoder’s capacity and the observed appearance while preserving the pretrained prior.

blocks.en: 2.1 3D reconstruction and generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 三维重建和生成

blocks.en:
High-fidelity 3D reconstruction was long dominated by per-scene optimization , from neural radiance fields [ 48 , 49 , 66 , 83 ] to 3D Gaussian Splatting [ 23 ] . Monocular depth estimation has simultaneously progressed from specialized predictors [ 57 ] to foundation-scale models [ 80 , 21 , 2 ] , while general 3D foundation models directly regress dense geometry and cameras from uncalibrated image collections [ 69 , 26 , 65 , 70 , 22 ] .
Building on these advances, feed-forward 3DGS models recover scene-level Gaussian representations from calibrated views [ 4 , 10 , 77 ] or uncalibrated image collections [ 40 , 35 , 16 , 13 , 46 ] , while recurrent refinement methods improve these predictions through rendering feedback [ 76 , 53 ] .
While faithful to the observed imagery, these methods reconstruct only visible geometry and do not recover complete, object-centric assets with explicit world-space grounding.

高纯度3D重建长期以平面优化为主,从神经发光场[48,49,66,83]到3D高斯平板. [23]. 单相深度估计同时从专业预测器[57]发展到地基尺度模型[80,21,2],而一般的3D地基模型直接从未校正的图像集合中回溯出密度几何和相机[69,26,65,70,22].
在这些进步的基础上,Feed-forward 3DGS模型从校正视图[4,10,77]或未校正图像集[40,35,16,13,46]中恢复了场景级别的高斯表示,而经常性的改进方法则通过提供反馈来改进这些预测[76,53].
这些方法虽然忠于所观测到的图像,但只重建可见几何,无法回收具有清晰的世界空间地平面的以物体为中心的完整资产。

blocks.en:
Complementary to reconstruction, object-centric generation infers complete geometry and appearance conditioned on text or sparse observations.
Early approaches distill pretrained 2D diffusion priors through score distillation [ 55 , 34 , 63 ] or improve the multi-view consistency of image-conditioned generation [ 38 , 41 , 42 ] , while large reconstruction models [ 14 , 78 , 5 ] bridge the two paradigms by regressing complete objects from single or sparse views.
Recent methods instead operate directly in native 3D representations, learning structured latent spaces over voxels, meshes, or Gaussian primitives [ 74 , 73 , 29 , 89 , 79 ] .
Pixal3D [ 28 ] departs from canonical-space generation by predicting pixel-aligned assets through explicit image-to-geometry correspondence.
ReconViaGen [ 3 ] and CUPID [ 15 ] narrow the gap
between generation and reconstruction through stronger learned alignment to the input:
ReconViaGen targets multi-view reconstruction, while CUPID jointly models object
generation and camera pose from a single image. These approaches rely on specialized
architectures and incorporate alignment directly into the training process; in contrast, we ground pose and appearance at inference
time on a frozen generator, with the same framework spanning monocular, multi-view,
and dynamic inputs.

blocks.en: 2.2 4D reconstruction and generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 4D重建和发电

blocks.en:
Dynamic reconstruction extends static reconstruction by enforcing temporal consistency across geometry, appearance, and motion. Early deformable neural rendering methods [ 56 , 51 , 52 , 11 , 43 , 81 , 71 , 82 , 67 , 25 ] optimize dynamic scenes for each video, introducing explicit time-varying Gaussian representations through persistent tracking, deformation fields, or compact motion models.
Per-scene monocular methods improve dynamic reconstruction via temporally consistent meshes [ 37 ] , better motion representations [ 33 , 72 ] , or diffusion-based inpainting of novel views [ 7 ] .
Other methods optimize over learned priors [ 88 , 8 , 30 , 45 ] or predict 4D geometry and motion directly [ 87 , 20 , 47 ] .
However, optimization-based methods are costly per sequence, and all of these methods recover geometry only for surfaces observed in the input, leaving unseen regions incomplete.
blocks.zh:
动态重建通过在几何、外观和运动之间加强时间一致性,延伸了静态重建。 早期可变形神经渲染方法 [56, 51, 52, 11, 43, 81, 71, 82, 67, 25] 优化了每个视频的动态场景,通过持续的跟踪,变形场,或紧凑的运动模型,引入了明显的时间变化的高斯表达.
单相机方法通过时间上一致的 meshes [37],更好的运动表现 [33,72],或以传播为主的对新观点的涂抹来改善动态重建 [7].
其他方法优于所学前科[88,8,30,45]或直接预测出4D几何和运动[87,20,47].
然而,以优化为基础的方法每个序列成本都很高,所有这些方法都只为输入所观察到的地表恢复几何,使得看不见的区域不完整.

blocks.en:
Generative video-to-4D introduces learned priors to aid or replace per-sequence optimization. Early approaches distill pretrained 2D diffusion models into dynamic representations and supervise 4D optimization using generated multi-view videos [ 17 , 31 , 75 ] .
Feed-forward methods directly predict temporally complete geometry from monocular videos [ 59 , 44 ] , while more recent work unifies reconstruction and generation in learned spatio-temporal latent spaces [ 86 , 84 , 60 , 61 ] .
Other works combine image-to-3D priors with per-sequence deformation optimization [ 6 , 36 , 64 , 62 ] .
blocks.zh:
Generative view-to-4D介绍所学的前科来帮助或取代每个序列的优化. 早期方法将预先训练的2D传播模型分馏入动态表达并使用生成的多视图视频监督4D优化[17,31,75].
Feed-forward方法直接预测从单视视频[59,44]中时间上完整的几何,而更近期的工作则统一了所学的斯皮提奥-时空潜入空间中的重建和生成[86,84,60,61].
其他作品将图像到3D前作与每序列变形优化[6,36,64,62]结合.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
Given posed observations, GenIA recovers input-aligned object reconstructions with per-frame world-space poses.
By default, SAM3D jointly denoises coarse shape and rotation. When external geometry is available, we instead inject it into SAM3D’s coarse latent representation ( Sec. 4.1 ) and keep the shape fixed while denoising rotation.
We then derive translation and scale from depth while retaining SAM3D’s rotation prior ( Sec. 4.2 ), recover a shared appearance representation using visibility and rendering constraints ( Sec. 4.3 ), and optionally refine the instance representation and world-space pose at test time ( Sec. 4.4 ). Figure 2 summarizes the pipeline.
All stages operate at inference time without updating the pretrained SAM3D weights;
optional refinement optimizes only an object-specific appearance latent, a lightweight
low-rank decoder adapter, and pose.

blocks.en:
We compare against state-of-the-art methods covering each of our input settings. Monocular static: We use SAM3D [ 9 ] as the geometry predictor and compare
against SAM3D, RecGen [ 85 ] ,
TripoSplat [ 79 ] , and CUPID [ 15 ] .
We additionally compare qualitatively with TRELLISv2 [ 73 ] and
Pixal3D [ 28 ] , whose lighting-disentangled material predictions lack
scene illumination and therefore do not support comparable photometric re-rendering. Multi-view static: We use MV-SAM3D [ 27 ] as the geometry backbone (implemented in our framework and parallelized) and evaluate with varying
numbers of input views. We compare against MV-SAM3D,
STREAM3D [ 90 ] , ReconViaGen [ 3 ] , and
RecGen [ 85 ] (up to two input views).
We further include Depth-3DGS [ 23 ] , a per-scene optimization baseline detailed in Sec. A.8 . Monocular dynamic: We use ActionMesh [ 60 ] canonical geometry and deformations, and recover
its missing world-space pose with our pose stage.
We compare against per-frame SAM3D, Lift4D [ 36 ] , which combines 3D mesh generation with per-scene object optimization, and the per-scene optimization baseline HiMoR [ 33 ] .
Additionally, we compare against Any4D [ 20 ] , which predicts temporal point clouds for 3D tracking.
We run all baselines on the same inputs as our method, including geometric priors where supported.

blocks.en:
We report foreground-masked PSNR on training views and LPIPS/CLIP-I on held-out views. Pixel-aligned metrics are sensitive to pose errors and penalize plausible completions that differ from ground truth, so we additionally report CLIP-I as a coarse semantic measure, despite its limited sensitivity to fine texture and temporal consistency ( Sec. A.13 ). To reduce pose-induced bias, we refine each method’s pose against the inputs while fixing shape and appearance; per-scene optimization methods are exempt ( Sec. A.10 ). On GSO-30 and ActionBench, co-PSNR further isolates held-out pixels visible in at least one input view.
For DAVIS, which lacks test views, we follow Lift4D [ 36 ] by synthesizing rotated novel views and averaging CLIP-I against the closest training image.
We evaluate tracking against CoTracker3 [ 19 ] pseudo-ground-truth using δ avg \delta_{\mathrm{avg}} , reprojection error (Err), and AJ; these scores measure agreement with CoTracker3 rather than absolute accuracy (see Sec. A.11 ).
blocks.zh:
我们报告关于培训观点的预告式PSNR和关于被搁置观点的LPIPS/CLIP-I。 与像素相匹配的度量衡对造成错误和惩罚与地面真理不同的合理完成十分敏感,因此,尽管CLIP-I对精细纹理和时间一致性的敏感度有限(Sec. A.13.),但我们又将它作为粗细的语义计量法报告。 为了减少由姿势引起的偏差,我们在固定外形和外观的同时,对每种方法的姿势进行了细化;免去每场场优化方法(Sec. A.10.)。 在GSO-30和Action Bench上,同为PSNR进一步将至少一个输入视图中可见的被持有出像素隔离出.
对于缺乏测试视图的DAVIS来说,我们跟随Lelf4D[36],通过将旋转的新观点合成,并平均使用CLIP-I来对抗最接近的训练图像.

blocks.en: 5.1 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.1 分析

blocks.en:
Across datasets, GenIA aligns the frozen SAM3D model to the inputs, improving pose and appearance reconstruction ( Tab. 1 ) while
remaining competitive on runtime ( Fig. 6 ).
blocks.zh:
在整个数据集中,GenIA将被冻结的SAM3D模型与输入一致,改进了外观和外观重建(Tab. 1),同时
(图6)

blocks.en:
In the single-view setting, SAM3D, RecGen, and TRELLISv2 can realistically complete unobserved geometry but often misalign appearance, especially for symmetric objects. Relative to SAM3D, we better resolve these ambiguities and improve color and lighting alignment, with gains extending to held-out views.
Pixal3D, TripoSplat, and CUPID are strongly input-aligned and even achieve higher co-PSNR than our method on synthetic scenes. However, they more frequently produce incomplete or washed-out occluded geometry or textures (see Fig. 5 ). On held-out views, our method achieves superior metrics, particularly on real scenes, while qualitatively better preserving backside geometry and appearance.
blocks.zh:
在单视图设定中,SAM3D,RecGen,和TRELLISv2可以现实地完成未观测到的几何,但经常会错位外观,特别是对对称对象而言. 相对于SAM3D,我们更好地解决了这些模糊不清的问题,并改进了色彩和照明的相接性,收益扩展到被搁置的视野.
Pixal3D,TripoSplatz,和CUPID是强烈的输入对接,甚至比我们在合成场景上的方法达到更高的同分PSNR. 然而,它们更经常地产生不完整或被冲出所覆盖的几何或纹理(见图5)。 在被搁置的观点上,我们的方法实现了优异的度量,特别是在真实的场景上,同时在质量上更好地保护了后侧几何和外观.

blocks.en: Similar misalignment persists for MV-SAM3D, STREAM3D, and RecGen in the multi-view setting, with ReconViaGen being the most input-aligned generative baseline. Without TTR, GenIA outperforms all baselines, including ReconViaGen. Depth-3DGS leads training-view PSNR and co-PSNR, but remains incomplete in unobserved regions. TTR further improves fidelity and perceptual quality.
blocks.zh: MV-SAM3D,STREAM3D,和RecGen在多视图设定中也持续出现类似的错位,ReconViaGen是最相通的基因基准. 没有TTR,GenIA就超越了所有的基线,包括ReconViaGen. 深度-3DGS领导培训-观点PSNR和同为PSNR,但在未观测到的地区仍然不完整. TTR进一步提高了忠诚度和知觉质量.

blocks.en:
On dynamic scenes, per-frame SAM3D is temporally inconsistent in geometry and appearance and provides no tracking correspondences.
HiMoR and Any4D reconstruct only observed regions.
Lift4D, the closest baseline to ours, is noisier and less temporally stable. In comparison, our method inherits the quality of the injected coarse geometry from ActionMesh and results in coherent shape and appearance.
With TTR, GenIA ranks second to HiMoR on DAVIS training-view PSNR and δ avg \delta_{\mathrm{avg}} , while achieving the lowest reprojection error and highest CLIP-I. On ActionBench, HiMoR leads training-view PSNR and co-PSNR, as expected for a per-scene optimizer fitted to the input view, while GenIA is on par with per-frame SAM3D and achieves the best held-out LPIPS. Per-frame SAM3D has the highest ActionBench CLIP-I, reflecting its insensitivity to pose alignment.
blocks.zh:
在动态场景上,每帧SAM3D在几何和外观上在时间上不一致,不提供跟踪通信.
HiMoR和Any4D只重建被观测到的区域.
离我们最近的基线Lelf4D是噪声,时间稳定性较低。 相形之下,我们的方法继承了从ActionMesh中注入的粗几何的质量,并产生了连贯的外形和外观.
随着TTR,GenIA在DAVIS training-view PSNR上排名第二位于HiMoR,而"Avg\delta_{\mathrm{avg}}"则实现了最小的再预测错误和最高的CLIP-I. 在Action Bench上,HiMoR领导了培训-view PSNR和同为PSNR,与输入视图相匹配的人均场景优化器,而GenIA与每帧SAM3D处于同等地位并实现了最好的被持有出LPIPS. 每帧SAM3D拥有最高的Action Bench CLIP-I,反映了它不敏感地提出对齐.

blocks.en:
Our method struggles on ActionBench scenes due to large inter-frame motion, where errors in the coarse geometry or pose can propagate and substantially degrade reconstruction.
Peak GPU memory on CO3D (1 input view) is 19.7 19.7 GB without TTR versus SAM3D’s 18.0 18.0 GB; TTR increases it to 31.8 31.8 GB due to back-propagation through the Gaussian decoder.
Additional results are provided in Sec. A.2 .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented GenIA, an inference-time framework that aligns a frozen generative 3D
prior to its observations. We ground translation and scale in depth while retaining the
prior’s rotation, and align appearance through visibility-biased attention, rendering
guidance, and cross-observation fusion.
This improves pose and novel-view quality for static monocular and multi-view inputs
and, with external dynamic geometry, yields temporally coherent reconstructions and
accurate tracks.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了GenIA,一个推论-时间框架 将冷冻基因3D
其意见之前。 我们深入地翻译和扩展,同时保留
Perform的自转,并通过对能见度的注意来调整外表,渲染
指导 和交叉观测聚变
这提高了静态单景和多景输入的姿势和新视觉质量
随着外部动态几何学的发展,在时间上进行了协调一致的重建,
准确的轨道。

blocks.en:
Dynamic geometry currently relies on an external predictor; removing this dependence would enable unified, input-aligned 3D/4D shape prediction. Unlike pose and appearance, coarse shape is not directly grounded in the observed silhouette and depth, as we found the geometry prior difficult to steer reliably.
Rotation remains prior-driven and only weakly corrected by noise-sensitive
registration, while pose errors from masks, depth, and cameras can also degrade the differentiable rendering supervision signal.
blocks.zh:
动态几何目前依赖于一个外部预测器;去除这种依赖性可以实现统一,输入相通的3D/4D形状预测. 与姿势和外观不同,粗糙的外形并不直接被所观测到的分光和深度所支撑,因为我们发现几何学之前很难可靠地进行引导.
旋转仍然是事先驱动的,只是通过对噪音敏感来微弱地纠正
登记,同时造成口罩出错,深度和相机也可以降解不同渲染监督信号.

blocks.en:
Pose misregistration can dominate pixel-aligned
object reconstruction metrics. We therefore report pose-refined results, keeping shape and appearance fixed
while optimizing only rotation, translation, and scale against the input observations.
For pose-predicting methods (e.g. SAM3D and MV-SAM3D), refinement starts from the

its best alignment to the inputs. Methods that reconstruct directly in the input camera

blocks.en:
Overall, the quantitative rankings broadly agree with the qualitative comparisons
( Figs. 12 , 13 , 14 and 15 ),
but each metric has limitations. PSNR remains sensitive to small residual
misalignments after pose refinement, so we interpret it together with LPIPS, which is
more tolerant to local shifts, and co-PSNR, which evaluates only regions constrained by
an input view.
CLIP-I varies over a relatively narrow range ( 0.71 0.71 – 0.91 0.91 in Tab. 1 ) and is comparatively tolerant to pose because each image is
cropped to its own object bounding box.
On ActionBench, per-frame SAM3D leads CLIP-I
( Tab. 1(b) ), whereas our reconstruction inherits ActionMesh deformation
and placement errors. With ground-truth geometry, the same appearance stage reaches 0.92 0.92 ( Tab. 3(b) ) versus 0.86 0.86 , indicating that geometry quality
strongly affects the score. TTR can further reduce CLIP-I when it fits the input view to
geometry that is inaccurate from the held-out viewpoint.
On DAVIS, CLIP-I compares each synthesized novel view with its corresponding input
frame, measuring appearance consistency under viewpoint change rather than
absolute reconstruction accuracy.
